name: California Central Valley
description: The long, flat farming valley between California's Coast Ranges and the Sierra Nevada.
why_it_matters: It grows a large share of U.S. fruit, nuts and vegetables and relies heavily on irrigation and groundwater.

name: Amazon Basin
description: The huge drainage area of the Amazon River and the world's largest tropical rainforest.
why_it_matters: Its forests store large amounts of carbon and recycle moisture that falls as rain across South America.

name: Murray–Darling Basin
description: Australia's largest river system, covering much of the south-east of the continent.
why_it_matters: It is Australia's main farming region and has swung between severe drought and major flooding.

name: Sahel
description: The semi-arid belt across Africa between the Sahara Desert and the wetter savannas to the south.
why_it_matters: Millions of people depend on its short rainy season for farming and grazing, so small rainfall changes matter a lot.
